initial_prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: art-direction reference for a Godot weather manipulation game called Weaving Rain; concept illustration, NOT a screenshot, no claim of running graphics. Primary request: a coherent wide gameplay-view scene showing restrained sculptural volume and a shared sun direction in our already chosen smooth contour, layered flat-color graphic art style. Camera: fixed orthographic oblique isometric view, landscape 16:9. Scene: one irregular grass island resting in a calm turquoise sea, one simple rounded mountain, one small rectangular farm with a few very simple sprout plants, one elliptical reservoir with a low pale stone rim and water visible below its inner wall. Large contiguous dynamic-looking cloud formation near and above the island; smooth connected silhouettes rather than separate spheres, pearl white illuminated top, pale gray-blue turning sides, darker cool blue-gray underside, FOUR broad clean tonal bands, tiny softened transition boundaries. Light arrives from upper left of the image; mountain, island shore side, stones, farm soil edge and reservoir walls agree with this direction. Subtle broad cool cloud shadow falls on the island and lightly on water; very soft shadow edges. Separate faint pale-cyan rainfall footprint below a short rain streak area, enough separation between a neutral cloud shadow and a cyan rain hint. Cloud shading communicates surface orientation but does not make every shaded cloud rainy: retain a small white thin-cloud edge with a shaded side and no rain. Island top brighter than its shallow vertical sandy shoreline side; farm is a very thin slab of brown soil, not a tall floating block; reservoir has obvious light rim, dark inner wall and contained flat blue water with two sparse curved water highlights. A few white moving-air line marks, no arrows everywhere. Composition uncluttered, plenty of sea negative space. Palette: muted sea teal, sage/gray green land, sand cream, pearl white and gray-blue clouds. Gentle color shading, vector-like digital illustration, quiet miniature-world atmosphere, clean smooth edges. No photographic textures, no glossy plastic, no bloom, no god rays, no sunset/night scene, no deep black shadows, no chibi houses, no trees or new gameplay objects, no cyclone eye, no cartoon spiral tornado. No user interface, no typography, no watermark. Preserve weather as the visual focus; this is a scene-material and lighting concept, not a UI redesign.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cloud-lighting study sheet for Weaving Rain. Landscape 16:9, three equal spacious panels on a calm muted teal background with subtle thin dividers. EXACTLY three cloud examples: left thin cloud, middle thick non-raining cloud, right thick raining cloud. Top small Chinese labels exactly "薄云", "厚云", "雨云". Every panel is the SAME orthographic oblique camera and upper-left light direction. Style: smooth connected asymmetric cloud bodies with broad sculptural tops and soft stretched edges, vector-like graphic rendering with four broad tone families: pearl white, very light gray-blue, middle gray-blue, deeper cool blue-gray. NOT a chain of round cotton balls, NOT a rectangle or plane with cloud picture painted on it. White lit tops and pale turning sides occur in ALL panels; a modest cool underside occurs even in the thin cloud. Thick non-raining cloud has a shaded underside but NO rain, clearly showing that shading and rainfall are different properties. Rain cloud is denser and its underside overall deeper blue-gray; simple pale-cyan rain streaks start strictly beneath the cloud bottom and end below, NEVER overlaying the cloud face. Thin cloud has a smaller translucent-looking edge, thick clouds larger vertical thickness; all have smooth continuous internal band boundaries, no pixel stepping or raymarch rings, no jagged contours, no noisy speckles. Under each cloud put only a small simple sage-green ground swatch at the same level, with a soft muted neutral blue-green cloud shadow; under the raining example add a separate extremely faint cyan rain footprint with a fine outline so it is distinguishable from cloud shadow. No arrows, no numeric values, no gameplay UI, no watermark. Quiet illustrative scene material reference rather than a photoreal volumetric rendering.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: close-up environmental-material reference for Weaving Rain, matching our restrained isometric weather-game style. Landscape 16:9; two generous side-by-side detail views, left a small rectangular farm, right an elliptical reservoir on the same muted sage-green ground. Shared orthographic oblique camera, warm-neutral light from upper left, consistent cool shaded right sides. LEFT: thin brown earth plot with a tiny visible soil edge and just three shallow broad row grooves, 8 sparse very simple sprout plants, thicker readable leaf silhouettes, lit leaf top and shaded side, small soft contact shadow beneath each plant. Soil remains shallow and within original rectangular footprint, not a tall floating cube. RIGHT: low pale sand/stone rim surrounding an elliptical water-holding area, lit rim top, darker inner wall visible above a moderately filled flat turquoise water surface, inner rim shading and a very slight bank reflection impression, two restrained curved water marks. Clear rim-water height difference, no excavation of an enormous canyon, no realistic animated waves, no shiny metallic material. Shore edge at the lower foreground has a short sand-colored side face to convey island thickness. Background mostly flat sage and turquoise negative space. All materials use only 2–3 broad clean value bands, smooth contours, vector-like digital illustration with gently softened tonal boundaries. This is an environment detail concept, not a set of gameplay/UI assets. No droplets, no buttons, no labels or lettering, no buildings, no characters, no elaborate fence, no dense foliage, no new mechanics, no photographic textures, no global glow, no hard black cast shadows, no watermark.

Exact shape language of image 2: smooth contours, broad pearl-white top shapes, pale gray-blue turning surfaces, middle/deeper gray-blue bottom shapes, only FOUR broad clean color bands. Absolutely no tiny cloud puff clusters, no dense stipple or detailed storm painting. Keep rain streaks strictly below the cloud; small soft neutral cloud shadow on the terrain; separate faint cyan rain footprint. Rebuild mountain as a SINGLE simple rounded green peak with 2–3 smooth broad value regions, no exposed craggy rock textures. Island has a shallow pale sand shoreline side face, no many rocks or decorative rocky coves. Farm remains one tiny rectangular soil plot with sparse sprouts, reservoir one elliptical low rim with flat blue water and visible inner wall. No new objects. Minimal white wind marks. Preserve quiet teal/sage/cream palette, generous sea space and clean composition. NO UI and no text, NO texture speckles or brush grain, NO photoreal shading, NO sun rays, NO bloom, no scenery far in the distance. This is restrained game scene lighting art direction, not a painted realistic landscape.

Smooth continuous rounded outer silhouette and clean internal region boundaries, narrow gentle anti-aliasing rather than foggy fuzzy surfaces. Keep a small simple flat sage ground swatch under each, soft muted neutral blue-green shadow, separate faint cyan rain footprint only in right panel. Dark shadowing in middle panel must not imply rainfall. Remove rocky/painted ground texture, glow, cloud noise and tiny turbulent protrusions.
